cases.about: A spec that stores a phone number with no retention and hands it to an unnamed provider: four data items tabled, two gaps quoting the spec and the policy, a pasteable fix for each.

documents.title: Spec — Order reminders by SMS
documents.content:
Spec — Order reminders by SMS

When a customer opts in at checkout we store their phone number with the order and send a reminder the day before delivery. The number is handed to the SMS provider. Order history picks the reminder time. Delivery status stops the reminders; it is kept 30 days.

documents.title: Privacy policy
documents.content:
Privacy policy

§4 Contact details are kept 12 months after the last order.
§6 Processors: Ledgerly (invoicing), Cloudbox (hosting). Each processor is named here and under a data processing agreement.

call.title: Privacy review — Spec — Order reminders by SMS
call.content:
Privacy review — Spec — Order reminders by SMS
ship with fixes: 4 data items, 2 gaps

## Verdict
Ship with fixes: the phone number and order history have a purpose and a home, but the spec keeps the number with no end date and sends it to an SMS provider it does not name.

## Data touched
| Item | Purpose | Where it goes | Kept for | Who sees it | Told? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phone number | send the reminder | orders table; "the SMS provider" | not stated | support, the provider | yes, at opt-in |
| Order history | pick the reminder time | orders table | per the policy, 12 months | support | yes |
| Opt-in time | prove consent | orders table | with the number | support | no |
| Delivery status | stop reminders | orders table | 30 days | support | no |

## Gaps
- Phone number — "store their phone number with the order" — Privacy policy §4: "Contact details are kept 12 months after the last order"; the spec names no period.
- Phone number — "handed to the SMS provider" — Privacy policy §6 names each processor; the provider is unnamed.

## Fixes
- Add: "Phone numbers are deleted 12 months after the customer's last order, with the rest of their contact details."
- Add: "SMS is sent through <provider>, under a data processing agreement; the provider is added to §6 before launch."

Privacy review — Spec — Order reminders by SMS
ship with fixes: 4 data items, 3 gaps

## Verdict
Ship with fixes: no policy is in the documents, so the UK rules apply; the phone number has no retention period, no named processor and no stated way for the customer to see or delete it.

## Data touched
| Item | Purpose | Where it goes | Kept for | Who sees it | Told? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phone number | send the reminder | orders table; "the SMS provider" | not stated | support, the provider | yes, at opt-in |
| Order history | pick the reminder time | orders table | not stated | support | yes |
| Opt-in time | prove consent | orders table | not stated | support | no |
| Delivery status | stop reminders | orders table | 30 days | support | no |

## Gaps
- Phone number — "store their phone number with the order" — UK rules: a retention period per item; none stated.
- Phone number — "handed to the SMS provider" — UK rules: processors named and under contract; the provider is unnamed.
- Phone number — no line gives the customer a way to see or delete it.

## Fixes
- Add a retention period for the number.
- Name the SMS provider and its agreement.
- Add: "Customers can remove their number from Account → Notifications."
